question: When and where was SAARC (South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation) formed?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bangladesh**,**1985**.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **SAARC** was founded on **8 December 1985 **in** Dhaka, Bangladesh.**
 
• The full form of SAARC is **South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation**.
 
 
• **Member states Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, the Maldives, Nepal, Pakistan, and Sri Lanka.**
 
• **Headquarters: Kathmandu, Nepal.**
 
• **Secretary general: Esala Weerakoon.**
 
 
 
• **The 2020 SAARC Summit **will take place in** Islamabad. Pakistan**.
